source_reviews.review_mode: Primary publisher full HTML Table1/note, Sections2/4/6.1 inspected. Five depth/area/distance-offshore values transcribed directly from Table1. references.geographic_scope: Nominal EAC-system cross-shore section at27.5S. Within OSW coherent coastal-jet reference latitude scope.
references.temporal_scope: ROMS simulation1January1994–1October2016; source approximately22-year mean alongshore velocity mask. Geometry of mean field, not a mean of instantaneous current masks or a dated observed section.
references.source_definition: Maximum depth of source cross-sectional region inside the−0.05m/s contour of mean alongshore velocity. Poleward flow has negative sign.
references.source_citation: Kerry and Roughan(2020), Downstream Evolution of the East Australian Current System: Mean Flow, Seasonal, and Intra-annual Variability, J.Geophys.Res.Oceans125:e2019JC015227, doi:10.1029/2019JC015227.
references.source_locator: Table1 depth/area/distance-offshore rows and note; Section4 mean-flow paragraph defining fixed transport mask; Section2 for period/grid orientation; Section6.1 for changing mean core geometry.
references.qualification: Maximum section-mask depth is not a constant bottom throughout the section or a full-current physical lower boundary. Table area belongs to the same fixed mean−0.05m/s mask and may support an explicitly reviewed regional core geometry scenario; distance offshore is not current width. Daily transport extrema inSv and seasonal transport amplitude are not water volume, depth extrema or area uncertainty. Do not blend different mean periods, observed mooring comparisons or stronger0.2/0.5m/s contours. Source grid is rotated20degrees clockwise; using section areas with an editorial along-route distance requires an explicit orientation/extrusion assumption. Sections32.3/33.9/36.2S are beyond the selected32S coastal-jet route and cannot silently extend it. No whole-flow thickness, seasonal depth envelope or whole-current volume.
